<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Voter empowerment:</strong> The Supreme Court has ruled that citizens can file complaints regarding false election affidavits directly, bypassing the need for prior Election Commission approval.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxOMUhHTm9IZW5kSHZRcFdhZHNXTy1YakF0VGJkY2pKX3BESDdGeEdYT3dUcHVVTGk0VWhBdHN3U2lKTWpSTmZBbE10TWctRU9qd3JwdmVvaVFIT2hiUkNHRVp1Tnl6dklqa20wbXRfdG51amtxS2t0RHFlYnItZ25fbjJyMnlXMmU1QVF6NkY0ZFdEQU4tVDhXckNVcw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>EC transparency:</strong> The Congress party has raised concerns regarding the Election Commission&#x27;s refusal to disclose details about the ECINET system and the software utilized for the System for Integrated Reporting (SIR).<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxPUUc0M1RFcW54NWJ2M2RIV21xVW1BLWRWMFdmVzJHeXFjblY1c1pHMEtOMlFSYV9hdnUzQ0RGdE9TWkJvblFYTDBCQ2d4NWoySWItbk4wSHR3OTJxbmt1d0k4TF9NM0xXVThRenhUbnJpYVVTUmwyVWJPY3RSU3duV3NJMm9XMHNzMEFNaTVJaTZNY2x2VWRRV2tWYWkySThrQU5uZXExZmdFeWZXUDRHc1pUcFA5WUpwelE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Judicial oversight:</strong> The Supreme Court has ordered the replacement of the trial judge in the Lakhimpur Kheri case following directives from the Allahabad High Court to address victim concerns.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE1ZalQtLXRheWdHZXNlS1dLTXpyWFFyU2x6SEhrQmNXSEFWV2NuWHMxaVRqRHFWZ3k2dzc5TWRsQzhZM3h2bU9wbk56Vm1SalpYRUt3T2U5MkZSeWVPcElpTlZGYmYyckdqTFZOZg?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Political allegations:</strong> Opposition leaders, including Akhilesh Yadav and Mamata Banerjee, have accused the BJP of using deceptive tactics and intimidation to influence voters and create rifts within the INDIA bloc.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxQY0dlNmNVdXpPUGd5NUpIMlBhR0dYUk9Mc0ZKRmNLNjZBRnVVSzM2UmgyQVNlOEYzdUNKb2hoY2lBODlKVW1vc2NsRElrTW01TFhpcU1weWtwcUE2RllULTJZN0dUUXFmeFB0S3VqYUVNQlRhVlg0VDJuQXNsV1FCU3ZNOXBRckh2eHFrd3RsUF8yYklrb0NObGxHSnpCZDJYaE02eVZuTjAtTk1pSmtpUnJEYUZ0Mm1ZUXYtMQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Environmental mandate:</strong> The Supreme Court has directed states to conduct physical verification and demarcation of water bodies, emphasizing the fundamental right to drinking water.</li>
</ul>
